Subject: Scheduling: Renewal QBR + Roadmap demo for BrightMed

Erica —

Congrats on the renewal milestone — excited to keep BrightMed moving forward. We should lock in a 60–75 minute Renewal QBR that includes a short roadmap demo (30–40m) focused on:
- 2029 performance & cost optimizations (batching/quant profiles)
- Dedicated capacity options and timeline
- Security controls you asked about (audit logs, KMS workflows)

Availability windows that work on our side next week (PST):
- Tue Nov 14: 09:00–11:30 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed Nov 15: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Thu Nov 16: 08:00–11:00

If those don't fit, tell me two 1-hour windows in BrightMed local time and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a small poll to collect attendees + SSH/IT contact for any network prep.

Notes: if procurement needs procurement-specific time (contract redlines / SOW), we can run that as a separate 30m the same day.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0162

Attachments: BrightMed_QBR_Agenda_v1.pdf (agenda, 1 page)
Poll: https://cal.poll/brightmed-qbr

Karthik —

Thanks for the note and congrats to the team. Appreciate the clear options. A couple of constraints from our side:
- Our execs prefer no meetings before 10:30 ET on Tue/Thu.
- We have a mandatory all-hands on Wed 11/15 morning (blocks 09:00–11:30 ET).
- Our procurement lead (Lena Park) is traveling 11/16–11/18 and would like any contract conversation before 11/16 EOD.

Given that, can we aim for: Tue 11/14 at 11:00 ET (which I think is your 08:00 PT) or Thu 11/16 at 10:30 ET? The earlier slot is preferable for exec availability. If you pick Tue 11/14 11:00 ET we’ll loop in more attendees and confirm network contacts.

One ask: can you include a brief slide on data residency and audit export cadence? BrightMed IT will want to review before the demo.

Erica Lang
Director, Clinical Data Strategy — BrightMed
erica.lang@brightmed.com

Karthik / Steph —

Looping in quick ops thoughts based on Erica's constraints. Proposed internal plan:
1) Aim to confirm Tue 11/14 at 11:00 ET (that maps to 08:00 PT). Exec availability is tight so we should keep to 60 minutes.
2) Prep packet: 12 slides max — 5 min exec summary, 25 min demo (live), 15 min roadmap/Q&A, 5–10 min procurement next steps. I attached a lean agenda (BrightMed_QBR_Agenda_v1.pdf).
3) Network prep: ask BrightMed IT for a single test SSH endpoint or allowlist (they'll send). We should offer a 15-min tech check Wed 11/8 or Mon 11/13.
4) Alternate slot: Thu 11/16 10:30 ET — we should mark that as backup if Lena confirms travel but wants procurement talk before EOD.

Action items for you, Karthik: please send a calendar invite with internal hosts (you, Marissa, Steph) and include the 15-min tech check optional invite. I'll publish the slim agenda to the shared drive (link below).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Erica —

Thanks for the quick reply. Tue 11/14 at 11:00 ET works for us — I’ve booked the 60-minute slot and attached the calendar invite. Seats: myself (host), Marissa (CS), Stephanie (Solutions), and a short slide pack that includes the data residency slide BrightMed IT requested.

Quick logistics:
- Tech check: Mon 11/13 11:00 ET (15 min) — optional, recommended for IT to validate allowlist.
- Prep materials: I shared BrightMed_QBR_Agenda_v1.pdf to your team, and Marissa uploaded a lean deck to the WorkDrive link.
- Procurement follow-up: Lena — happy to run a 30-min redline session immediately after the QBR on Tue 11/14 at 12:05 ET if that helps (we'll hold a soft slot). Please confirm if Lena can make that.
